decisions.reason: The approved photo folder and mandatory-photo rule do not change the established Blue Mesa brand identity, logo, or color requirements.
The source specifies photo selection and does not establish or change any typography requirement.
Requiring selected photos to appear does not change the existing requirement to lay out the complete document.
The task-specific photo source and selection rule do not alter the deferred modular-template requirement for future proposals.
The photo-selection instruction does not affect Canva editing access, ownership, or asset-license constraints.
The source concerns photographs only and leaves organization-chart inclusion unchanged.
The source does not change the requirement to integrate supplied tables or the budget sheet.
Mandatory inclusion of selected photographs does not explicitly change the 34-page maximum.
The photo instruction does not alter the final PDF count, print readiness, email submission, compatibility, or export-quality requirements.
The general requirement to package all required response content remains valid unchanged; the specific photo-selection rule is already owned by the source Requirement.
The source identifies required photographs but does not change the fixed section order or permit section reordering.
This Requirement belongs to the separate RCP proposal, while the source instruction concerns photographs for the Civic Canopy RFQ.
